Malay, English and Japanese for life in Malaysia

Chapter guide

How the syllabus was designed

Malay begins with the teacher’s own sequence for adults in Malaysia. Level labels are local teaching targets. The Ministry’s KSBM framework informs competency review. For English, English Profile informs vocabulary grading. Across languages the CEFR descriptors guide communicative outcomes.

The progression from model to independent exchange draws on Minna no Nihongo. Everyday tasks draw on Irodori. Each chapter includes recall, worked examples, independent practice and a later return to the skill. See the IES practice guide.
